purpose: Execute client-approved repair actions using native .NET APIs and ordinary Windows system tools (sfc, DISM, chkdsk, netsh, cleanmgr, wsreset, powercfg) plus file/registry work. Never PowerShell; nothing downloaded or executed from the network. This is the ONE canonical repair engine - it replaces the three drifting implementations the audit found (I1).

capabilities.name: cleanup
capabilities.function: Clear temp files, browser/Windows caches, recycle bin, update leftovers, Delivery Optimization, Windows.old (presence-gated).

capabilities.name: system_repair
capabilities.function: sfc /scannow, DISM RestoreHealth/StartComponentCleanup, chkdsk /scan, Windows Update component reset.

capabilities.name: performance
capabilities.function: Disable startup items (registry), power plan, visual effects, Windows Store cache.

capabilities.name: truthful_result_rows
capabilities.function: Each action returns { action, name, status: done|noted|skipped|error, mb_freed, detail } with real byte counts - the referents the Custodian stage's signs are bound to.

expected_outputs: result row per approved action with a real status
mb_freed reflects actual bytes deleted, not an estimate
irreversible actions (remove_windows_old) are presence-gated and never run when absent

evidence.source: Placed from StoreApp/Repair.cs (audit I4 PASS: reversible/safe, truthful rows; catalogue >= 18 PASS). trust_state=provisional: one Auditor pass. Promotion to verified requires the full 3/5 independent-reviewer marker promotion, builder excluded.
